kicker: For the blessing you forgot to thank Him for
truth: All ten were healed. Only one came back to say thank you.
accent: Only one came back to say thank you.
prayer: Lord, forgive me for the prayers You already answered that I never circled back to thank You for. Teach my heart to turn around, not just when I need something, but because I remember what You've already done. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

save: Save this for the blessing you forgot
